clue.text: Display a bowl of cereal

parts.note: bran is the husk of cereal grain, eaten as a breakfast cereal
a dish is a shallow bowl

explanation.surface: Someone shows off their breakfast bowl of cereal.
explanation.definitionFit: To flourish or wave something about ostentatiously is to show it off, a synonym of display used as a verb.

clue.text: Sticks up for superior

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the word is read from the bottom upwards, backwards

parts.note: gums are glues, things that stick, so sticks as a verb can mean gums

explanation.surface: Someone defends a person who considers themselves above others.
explanation.definitionFit: A self-satisfied, condescending person feels superior; the two adjectives are close synonyms of complacent pride.

clue.text: Time to run in field

parts.note: sec is short for second, a unit of time
R is the cricket abbreviation for run

explanation.surface: A moment to go for a run across a field.
explanation.definitionFit: A field of activity or business is a sector, as in the public sector; the two nouns are synonyms.

clue.text: Footballer, one taking action over conditions

definitions.meaning: a forward whose job is to score goals
a worker who walks out in industrial action over pay or working conditions

explanation.surface: A footballer protesting about something.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses share one word: the attacking player and the worker on strike.

clue.text: Arrived to gloat at animal supervisor

parts.note: came is the past tense of come, meaning arrived
to leer is to look with sly, gloating or lustful pleasure

explanation.surface: Someone turned up just to gloat at a zookeeper.
explanation.definitionFit: A driver or keeper of camels is someone who looks after animals, a supervisor of the beasts.

clue.text: Organise change of decoration

indicators.note: a change of these letters means they are rearranged into a new order

explanation.surface: An instruction to arrange a redecorating job.
explanation.definitionFit: To bring elements into a working arrangement is to organise them; the verbs are synonyms.

clue.text: By mistake his men get engaged

indicators.note: letters put down by mistake are in the wrong order, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: Some soldiers accidentally find themselves in battle.
explanation.definitionFit: Gears that mesh are engaged, interlocking with each other, so the phrase means connected or involved.

clue.text: Bared tum? Could be for a tattoo!

indicators.note: says the letters could be something else when rearranged

explanation.surface: A bare belly might be the place for an inked design.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface wants a tattoo on skin; here it is the military sense, a drum signal.
explanation.definitionFit: A tattoo is also a rhythmic drum signal recalling soldiers to quarters, a crossword-favourite sense.

clue.text: Embellish trouble with the navy

parts.note: ado is fuss or trouble, as in much ado
RN is the Royal Navy, Britain's naval service

explanation.surface: Decorating a problem by adding sailors.
explanation.definitionFit: To decorate or add ornament to something is to embellish it; the verbs are synonyms.

clue.text: Catch navy in decline

indicators.note: says the navy letter sits within the word for decline

parts.note: to sag is to sink or droop, a decline

explanation.surface: Trying to catch sailors whose numbers are falling.
explanation.definitionFit: A catch is a hidden drawback or difficulty, and so is a snag.

clue.text: Cloth samples found in the bathroom

definitions.note: describes items kept there, a plural noun phrase

parts.note: toile is a light linen or cotton fabric
tries as a noun are tastings, samples or attempts

explanation.surface: Fabric swatches turning up in the bathroom.
explanation.definitionFit: Soap, shampoo and similar washing items are the things one keeps beside the basin.

clue.text: Refuse to give birth

definitions.meaning: the noun meaning rubbish, not the verb meaning decline
of animals, to bear a brood of young

explanation.surface: Someone declining to have a baby.
explanation.walkthrough: Refuse reads as a verb, decline; it is the noun, rubbish.
explanation.definitionFit: Rubbish strewn about is called by the same word that names bearing a brood of puppies or kittens.

clue.text: Ridicule Romeo on defect in crockery

parts.note: to tease is to mock or make fun of
Romeo is R in the NATO phonetic alphabet
a vice is a fault or failing

explanation.surface: Mocking a lover over a flaw in a teacup.
explanation.definitionFit: A matching set of cups, saucers and pot is an example of tableware, a set of crockery.

clue.text: Rowers keeping right makes sense

indicators.note: the crew word holds the other word within it

parts.note: an eight is a racing boat crew of eight oarsmen
right! as an exclamation of agreement means yes

explanation.surface: A boat crew staying on the correct side is the sensible course.
explanation.definitionFit: Sight is one of the five senses, the faculty of seeing.

clue.text: Greek character ill-disposed to wine

parts.note: chi is a letter of the Greek alphabet
anti means opposed to or against

explanation.surface: A Greek who dislikes a particular wine.
explanation.definitionFit: A red wine from Tuscany is an example of wine.

clue.text: Tory leader (queer fish) is walking unsteadily

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its first letter

parts.note: queer in its old sense of strange means odd
ling is a long-bodied sea fish of the cod family

explanation.surface: A strange Conservative leader staggering about.
explanation.walkthrough: Fish reads as a noun describing the leader; it supplies the fish.
explanation.definitionFit: A small child taking its first tottering steps is moving about on uncertain legs.

clue.text: Trotsky's initial explanation for mutiny

indicators.note: a word's initial is its first letter

parts.note: a reason is an explanation or cause

explanation.surface: A revolutionary's first account of an uprising.
explanation.definitionFit: Mutiny is rebellion against authority, a betrayal of allegiance like treachery against the state.

clue.text: Anomalies providing chances to secure international match

indicators.note: the chances word holds the other pieces fast within it

parts.note: odds are the likelihood or chances of something
a tie is a sporting fixture, as in a cup tie

explanation.surface: Bookmakers' odds offered for clinching an international game turn out strange.
explanation.definitionFit: Peculiar things, irregularities or curiosities are anomalies; the plural nouns are synonyms.

clue.text: Ought children tuck into cheese and bread?

indicators.note: the zero and children letters go inside the cheese word

parts.note: Brie is a soft French cheese
ought, also spelt aught, is an old word for nought, zero, which looks like O

explanation.surface: Should youngsters be allowed to eat cheese and bread?
explanation.walkthrough: Ought reads as the verb 'should'; it is nought. Tuck into is eating in the surface but placing inside here.
explanation.definitionFit: A sweet, rich French roll made with butter and eggs is a kind of bread.

clue.text: Miscreant makes proposition about the outcome

indicators.note: the proposal word goes around the other piece

parts.note: an offer is a proposal or proposition
the end is the result or outcome

explanation.surface: A wrongdoer proposes a deal concerning the result.
explanation.definitionFit: A wrongdoer or lawbreaker is a miscreant; the nouns are synonyms.

clue.text: A way of cooking meat in France and Spain

indicators.note: says the meat goes inside the two country letters

parts.note: F is the international vehicle code for France
E is the international vehicle code for Spain (España)
lamb is meat from a young sheep

explanation.surface: A cooking method for meat used in two European countries.
explanation.definitionFit: Food doused in spirit and set alight is prepared by one particular culinary technique.

clue.text: Bishop gives permission to use combinations

parts.note: B is the chess abbreviation for bishop
someone who lends lets another borrow and use a thing

explanation.surface: A cleric allows something to be borrowed.
explanation.definitionFit: Mixtures of things combined are combinations, as with tea or whisky mixes.

clue.text: Type of pottery made by graduate and seaman

parts.note: a BA is a Bachelor of Arts, a graduate
an old salt is an experienced sailor

explanation.surface: Ceramics made by a student and a sailor.
explanation.definitionFit: Wedgwood made a black unglazed stoneware named after the volcanic rock, a type of pottery.

clue.text: Overall sum becomes great

indicators.note: the letters become something new, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: A total figure turns out to be large.
explanation.definitionFit: Wonderful or excellent things are great in the colloquial sense; the adjectives are synonyms.

clue.text: Tackle English bird

parts.note: tackle means gear or equipment, kit

explanation.surface: Taking on a British bird.
explanation.walkthrough: Tackle reads as a verb, confront; it is the noun, equipment.
explanation.definitionFit: A fork-tailed bird of prey of the hawk family is a kind of bird.

clue.text: Speed of a bird

definitions.meaning: a unit of speed at sea, one nautical mile per hour

explanation.surface: How fast a bird flies.
explanation.definitionFit: The nautical speed unit and the sandpiper share one word.

clue.text: Painter is a bit of a swine

definitions.meaning: cured meat from the back or side of a pig

explanation.surface: An artist who is rather a nasty piece of work.
explanation.walkthrough: A bit of a swine looks like mild abuse; it is literally a part of a pig.
explanation.definitionFit: The artist's surname is also the cured pork, a portion of a pig.

clue.text: Blessed husband's given consent

parts.note: H is an abbreviation for husband; the 's is read as 'has'
allowed means permitted, given consent

explanation.surface: A happy husband has had his wish granted.
explanation.definitionFit: Something made holy or consecrated is blessed, as in hallowed ground.
